gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i2: Tests for {@link ReaderInputStream}, which adapts a {@link Reader} (character stream) into an {@link java.io.InputStream} (byte stream) using a {@link CharsetEn
ADDED i3: Closing the stream should mark it as closed.
ADDED i4: A stream built via the builder from a byte array starts out open.
ADDED i5: A null encoder falls back to the default charset; reading returns the first byte.
ADDED i6: '{' encodes to byte 123 under the default charset.
ADDED i7: Skipping more than is available skips only the single available byte.
ADDED i8: Skipping on an empty source skips nothing, and a subsequent read reports EOF.
ADDED i9: Reading into an array fills it and leaves the remaining encoded bytes available.
ADDED i10: A buffer size smaller than the encoder's minimum is rejected.
ADDED i12: Setting a charset on the builder leaves the default buffer size unchanged.
ADDED i13: A freshly created builder exposes a default encoder with 3 max bytes per char.
ADDED i14: The stream exposes the encoder derived from the supplied charset.
ADDED i15: Before any read, no encoded bytes are available.
ADDED i16: Setting a charset encoder on the builder leaves the default buffer size unchanged.
ADDED i17: A null charset name falls back to the default charset; the stream starts open.
ADDED i18: Reading into a zero-length array reads no bytes.
